mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.1%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following FEDFUNDS levels below 0.1% over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE rising more than 0.3 percentage points over three months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day periods following a UNRATE increase of >0.3pp over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which signals reduced corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 60-day periods following simultaneous declines in HOUST and RSAFS (each down > 0.5% MoM) over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO above 100) indicates robust supply-side economic expansion, which supports corporate profit growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the 20-day periods when INDPRO > 100 over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL rising more than 0.2 percentage points over three months) signals potential monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day periods following a CPIAUCSL increase of >0.2pp over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a severe supply-side economic contraction, which signals reduced corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 60-day periods following simultaneous declines in INDPRO and GDPC1 (each down > 0.5% MoM) over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the 5-day periods when UNRATE is below 4.0% over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST above 700,000 units) indicates robust consumer confidence and spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the 20-day periods when HOUST > 700k units over the last 10 years.
